title: How Does Your Phone Know Which Way Is Down? 🤔 #shorts
description:
There's a tiny moving weight inside your phone right now, and it's how your screen knows up from down.
⚙️ A microscopic mass on springs, suspended between two capacitor plates
📐 How a 2-micrometer gap turns into a measurable signal
🔴 Why the capacitance difference (ΔC) is the real error signal
⚡ How that signal becomes a clean voltage, then a g-force reading
